solution:
Using $\log_2 A+\log_2 B=\log_2(AB)$ (valid for $x>1$):
$$\log_2\big((x+2)(x-1)\big)=2\quad\Rightarrow\quad (x+2)(x-1)=2^2=4.$$
So $x^2+x-2=4$, i.e. $x^2+x-6=0=(x+3)(x-2)$. Hence $x=2$ or $x=-3$. But the logarithms require $x>1$, so $x=-3$ is extraneous. The only solution is $x=2$.
hints: Combine the logs: log2 of the product equals 2.
Check the domain x>1 to reject extraneous roots.
